added.title: Software Engineer
added.description:
Job ID: 10168

Date Posted: November 16, 2026

Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) is in search of a Software Engineer to develop, maintain, and improve software used to support ground support equipment (GSE), automated testing, and embedded systems across multiple programs in our CVS Division. The selected candidate will work closely with engineers and technicians to translate test requirements and procedures into reliable, repeatable automated test sequences, including equipment control, command and response handling, data collection, comparison to expected results, pass/fail determination, and automated report generation. The role will also develop and maintain telemetry and test-data processing capabilities that support quick-look review, long-term trending, serial-number-based test history, and other data-driven analysis.

The engineer will also learn the architecture and operation of existing GSE software from experienced team members, capture that knowledge through strong documentation, and progressively take ownership of maintaining and modernizing the capability. The selected candidate must be able to work as part of larger engineering teams, internal and external to the organization, and take ownership of assigned software capabilities from requirements and architecture through implementation, test, documentation, deployment, and ongoing support.

The Civil & Commercial Space (CVS) Division is at the forefront of scientific research and space exploration. We equip major Government and commercial missions with calibrated state-of-the-art sensors and satellites. We also provide world-class AI&T technologies and mission management. Our projects include challenges across planetary science, Earth observation, heliophysics, and astrophysics. Be part of a team that pushes the boundaries of what’s possible in space and contributes to monumental scientific discoveries.

This position is full-time and is located in Logan, UT.

Required Qualifications

Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., or other U.S. person
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, or electrical engineering
Experience developing software in Python
Prior embedded software development experience
Experience developing automated test frameworks, including automated test execution, comparison against expected results, pass/fail determination, and automated report generation
Experience using Git or other version control in a collaborative software development environment
Ability to develop maintainable, modular, and reusable software architectures that can support multiple programs and hardware configurations
Ability to troubleshoot and debug issues across software, embedded systems, interfaces, and connected test hardware
Ability to work with engineers and technicians to translate test requirements and procedures into automated tests
Ability to create and maintain clear software documentation, including user manuals, operating instructions, feature descriptions, and appropriate code-level documentation
Ability to communicate effectively, work collaboratively, and take ownership of assigned software from requirements through implementation, test, documentation, deployment, and support

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing software that interfaces with laboratory equipment, ground support equipment, embedded hardware, and external devices
Experience with C/C++ development, particularly for maintaining or modernizing existing GSE software
Experience using Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) for Windows operating systems
Experience with hardware communication interfaces and protocols such as Ethernet, serial, USB, or similar interfaces
Experience with Linux development environments
Experience with Rust, or demonstrated ability and interest in becoming proficient in Rust
Experience developing embedded flight software
Experience with flight software development processes, including verification and validation, configuration control, formal testing, and demonstrating software readiness for flight use
Experience working on NASA, DoD, or other U.S. Government space programs
Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools used responsibly to improve productivity, code quality, documentation, or maintainability
Master’s Degree

Salary Range
$63,000 - $120,000
Salary commensurate on education and relevant experience

This range serves as a general guideline and may vary based on factors such as role, level, location, market conditions, and individual qualifications, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. The range displayed in the job advertisement reflects the minimum and maximum target salaries across all U.S. locations. Specific salary details for a candidate’s preferred location can be provided by the recruiter or HR manager during the hiring process.

Why Join SDL?

SDL offers competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Visit our Benefits Page to learn more about what we offer.

SDL delivers advanced multi-domain solutions to protect national security and enable scientific discovery. Our expertise in satellites, sensors and instruments, ground systems and data processing, and autonomous systems plays a critical role in missions supporting NASA and the Department of Defense. Join our team of engineers, scientists, technicians, and business professionals in our seventh decade of delivering mission success.

At SDL, we strive to uphold a culture of respect, collaboration, empowerment, and accountability. We listen with open minds, seek to understand diverse perspectives, and engage in thoughtful dialogue. We work together by sharing knowledge, involving others, and offering support. We trust and empower our team members to take ownership, act with integrity, and be accountable. Above all, we deliver on our commitments to each other and to our mission partners.

added.description:

The Software Engineer codes software applications based on business requirements. The Software Engineer work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

For new hires, this position is limited to the following approved hiring locations:

Nashville, TN

Louisville, KY

Dallas, TX

Tampa, FL

This role follows a hybrid work model and is not eligible for remote work. Candidates must reside in, or be willing to relocate to, one of the approved locations and work onsite in accordance with team and business requirements.

The Software Engineer standardizes the quality assurance procedure for software. Oversees testing and debugging and develops fixes. Research complaints and make necessary adjustments and/or recommendations to resolve complex software related issues. Begins to influence the department's strategy. Makes decisions regarding technical approaches for project components, and work is performed without direction. Exercises considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, architects, engineers, and platform teams to understand business objectives, technical requirements, workflows, and success criteria.
Lead technical discovery sessions and translate ambiguous requirements into clear architecture, implementation plans, and engineering deliverables.
Design, develop, test, deploy, and support scalable full-stack applications across web, backend, cloud, data, automation, and AI-enabled use cases.
Build responsive and maintainable front-end applications using modern frameworks such as Vue.js/ React/Angular/Next.js.
Design and implement backend services, APIs, integrations, and microservices using Python
Develop cloud-native solutions using Azure/ Google Cloud Platform/AWS, including compute, storage, identity, networking, serverless, managed databases, monitoring, and logging services.
Build prototypes, proofs of concept, and production-ready solutions for automation, AI-enabled workflows, and digital transformation initiatives.
Integrate AI capabilities into applications using enterprise-approved AI platforms, APIs, SDKs, and cloud AI services.
Design and implement automation solutions for business processes, software delivery, testing, monitoring, reporting, operational support, and developer productivity.
Collaborate with product management and core engineering teams to provide field feedback and influence solution design, platform patterns, and roadmap priorities.
Implement CI/CD pipelines, pipeline code, automated testing, release automation, deployment automation, and environment promotion practices.

Required Qualifications

Use your skills to make an impact

Bachelor's Degree or equivalent/relevant experience in lieu of degree requirement.
Minimum 3 years' experience in full-stack engineering experience designing, building, testing, and supporting modern applications across front-end, back-end, cloud, and DevOps environments.
Minimum 3 years' experience in hands-on experience with modern front-end such as React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, React Native, iOS, or Android development patterns.
3+ years' experience in back-end engineering experience with Node.js, .NET, or Java, including RESTful APIs, microservices, event-driven services, authentication, authorization, performance optimization, observability, and error handling.
Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms, and containerized application environments, including technologies such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, AKS, GKE, or EKS.
Strong DevOps and secure engineering experience, including Git-based workflows, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD automation, pipeline-as-code using YAML or equivalent, automated deployments, scripting, code quality tooling, and secure software supply chain practices.
Practical experience applying AI-enabled capabilities to software engineering, automation, application integration, productivity, or business process improvement, including use of APIs, SDKs, cloud AI services, generative AI, LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, or retrieval-augmented generation patterns.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise API management platforms, API gateway solutions, or large-scale API governance patterns.
Real-world experience using claude code/codex or other assistive coding technology
Experience with GitOps-based deployment models and tools such as ArgoCD.

Associates who live and work from Home in the state of California, Illinois, Montana, or South Dakota will be provided a bi-weekly payment for their internet expense.

ENTERPRISE STUDENT AND ADMIN S (UA-ESHR-IUINA)

At University Information Technology Services (UITS), we offer a workplace that supports growth, flexibility and creativity, with university-wide programs that support employee well-being. Our core values guide how we work and what we aim for, so we can make a positive impact in every neighborhood, community and county we serve. We believe in each person's potential, and we'll help someone reach theirs.

The Enterprise Library Systems (ELS) team develops and supports Indiana University's library systems. These include the SirsiDynix Symphony Library Management System, the IU online catalog (IUCAT), and a locally developed, Bento-style library discovery tool. ELS also provides infrastructure for enterprise scholarly systems, including Digital Collections, Media Collections Online (Avalon), Pages Online and Imago. We work closely with academic and administrative partners across IU, and we work in an agile, team-based way.

ELS is part of the Enterprise Student and Administrative Systems (ESAS) unit. We are looking for a collaborative Software Engineer with experience developing, maintaining and supporting web applications and services. In this role, you will work with senior engineers on the team to deliver and improve the systems IU Libraries depends on, and grow your skills along the way. ESAS values quality work, sensible use of automation and standards, continuous learning and collaboration, working solutions, and data-informed decisions.

Bring your skills and learn new ones. There's always something new to learn here.

Collaborates with other technical staff and stakeholders/clients to ensure optimum functionality, performance, accessibility, scalability, and security of supported software.

Contributes to project planning, formulating objectives, estimating tasks; performs studies to include feasibility, conceptual design, cost/benefit analysis, development and implementation planning.
Ensures that all protocols used in the development and maintenance of software is up to date and compliant with university policies and standards; researches and stays up-to-date on new industry software development standards, emerging technology, UX/UI design/philosophy, and accessibility standards.

added.description:
Who We Are

Imprint helps the world's best brands grow the lifetime value of their customers. We started with co-branded credit cards and rebuilt them to be smarter, more rewarding, and brand-first. We partner with companies like Crate & Barrel, Rakuten, Booking.com, H-E-B, Fetch, and Shell to launch modern credit programs that deepen loyalty, unlock savings, and drive growth. But the card is just the beginning. We combine advanced payments infrastructure, intelligent underwriting, and deep customer data to create delightful and personalized experiences for members as well as efficient and profitable relationships for our brand partners. Our robust technology and world-class operations allow us and our brand partners to offer powerful financial products without becoming a bank.

In the U.S., co-branded cards alone account for over $300 billion in annual spend, and most still run on decades-old legacy bank systems. Imprint is the modern alternative: flexible, embeddable, and built for how people actually pay today. Role Description

Defense Unicorns is seeking a Data Engineer to embed with a government team and its technology partners building an emerging AI-powered engineering ecosystem.

This role will focus on making enterprise data usable, discoverable, governed, and accessible to AI models, agents, and mission applications. The engineer will work across data ingestion, transformation, storage, metadata, APIs, search, vector and graph technologies, and the interfaces between the data layer and AI workloads.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineer who can operate across the full data lifecycle and understands that data availability and integration are often the primary blockers to delivering AI capabilities. They should be comfortable entering an evolving architecture, learning unfamiliar systems quickly, working directly with commercial technology partners, and solving difficult problems involving data quality, lineage, access, performance, and security.

This is not a traditional analytics or business intelligence role. The focus is on building the data foundations and repeatable patterns that allow AI and agentic capabilities to access trusted data and move from prototype to production in secure and classified environments.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines that ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data for AI models, agents, and mission applications.
Integrate structured and unstructured data sources into enterprise data services, including relational, document, vector, and graph-oriented technologies.
Work closely with AI/agent engineers to make data discoverable and usable for RAG, semantic search, model context, and tool-enabled agent workflows.
Develop repeatable data ingestion and transformation patterns using Python, SQL, APIs, event-driven architectures, and workflow/orchestration technologies.
Establish data quality, validation, provenance, lineage, and metadata practices so downstream users and AI systems can trust the information they consume.
Design data access patterns that enforce appropriate identity, authorization, classification, and security boundaries while minimizing unnecessary friction for developers and mission users.
Collaborate with platform engineers to operationalize data services within Kubernetes/OpenShift environments and integrate them into CI/CD and GitOps workflows.
Help integrate enterprise data capabilities such as relational stores, JSON/document data, vector search, graph data, advanced analytics, and RAG services into the broader platform architecture.
Troubleshoot end-to-end data issues spanning source systems, pipelines, storage, APIs, identity, networking, platform services, and AI applications.
Work directly with government engineers and commercial technology partners to resolve data dependencies and remove blockers to mission delivery.
Develop documentation, data contracts, schemas, architecture decision records, runbooks, and operational standards that make successful patterns repeatable across environments.
Identify recurring data engineering challenges that can be standardized, automated, or productized rather than repeatedly solved through manual engineering.
Operate effectively in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where data sources, architectures, security requirements, and mission priorities will continue to evolve.

Local to the National Capital Region and able to support onsite work at a government facility in Springfield, VA as mission needs increase.

Minimum Experience And Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance.

Hands-on experience building and operating production data pipelines and ETL/ELT workflows.

added.title: Software Engineer, Data Platform
added.description:
Why Numeric

Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era.
Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.

Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on.
We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP)
, a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one.

We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We’re in-person, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There’s never been a better time to join.

About The Role

Numeric’s product is, at bottom, data: your accounting history, your ability to pass an audit, your capacity to catch mistakes before your auditors do. The Data Infrastructure team builds the financial data plane that makes that possible — the lakehouse that ingests raw data from ERPs, banks, payment processors, and customer warehouses, transforms it into typed canonical tables, and serves it to our accounting modules, reporting engine, and AI agents. We’re mid-way through a deliberate architectural bet (ClickHouse-backed lakehouse, SQLMesh, per-tenant isolation) and it is the layer we expect to carry the most new investment this year. Every engineer on the team owns a slice of the architecture end to end.

What You Might Work On

Ingestion at scale: incremental, watermark-based extraction from API sources (NetSuite, Stripe, Brex, Ramp, HubSpot…), file-based S3 inboxes, and Postgres → ClickHouse replication — and making each new source cheap to add.
Data contracts & typed source data: stop downstream consumers from touching untyped raw JSON; enforce schemas at the boundary and make datasets discoverable.
Data Lakehouse schema management: a single declare → codegen → apply pipeline so schema intent is codified, reviewable, and applied consistently across tenants.
Data Security: Scoping queries, building ACLs, and ensuring that we never, ever compromise our customer’s trust
Batch processing & event-driven accounting: decouple event processing from downstream failures; give operators clear “what ran, what failed, and why” answers.
Data correctness & observability: completeness checks rooted in platform data, ingestion health, two-phase re-ingest, and explanatory links from ledger entries back to raw events.
Reporting scalability: the query patterns and materializations that let reporting drill from a board-level P&L to a single transaction without falling over.
Tons of other stuff!

You might be a great fit if you…

Have built or operated data pipelines / lakehouse / warehouse systems in production and have opinions about ETLs, idempotency, watermarks, and backfills.
Treat auditability and “fail early, fail explicitly” as design constraints, not afterthoughts.
Are comfortable across the stack: TypeScript services, SQL (ClickHouse and Postgres), and transformation tooling like SQLMesh or dbt.
Like being close to the consumers of your data — accounting module engineers, the reporting team, and agents — and shaping the interfaces they use.
Want to learn how accountants think about source data, completeness, and close, and let that shape what you build.

What You Need

3+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time on data-intensive systems.
Strong SQL and a working understanding of columnar stores, partitioning, and query performance.
Experience with a modern transformation / orchestration stack (SQLMesh, dbt, Dagster, Airflow, or similar).
Strong general-purpose programming (we’re primarily TypeScript, with Python mixed in).

Nice to have

ClickHouse, Iceberg, or Athena experience.
Multi-tenant data isolation, PII handling, or SOC 2 / audit-driven controls.
Prior exposure to financial or accounting data (ERPs, GL, subledgers).
Experience with orchestration systems like Temporal or Inngest

Stack:
TypeScript / Node, Postgres, ClickHouse (ClickPipes), SQLMesh, S3 / Athena, Inngest, AWS.

How We Work

This role is in-person in New York
(in office, with flexibility).

As an engineer at Numeric you will learn the domain, meet your users, and exercise substantial creativity and agency over product direction. You'll work with a high-pace, high-integrity team that loves collaboration.

We believe the best company is the one with the best ICs and we’ve built a culture to maximize great work. We believe great product & engineering come from a desire to win, a deep care for the craft, and a pragmatism in shipping for overall impact. As engineers we ground our work in our understanding of the users, the domain, and the goals for our organization.

We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:

Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.
Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.
Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.
Earn the right: Our ability to rethink how things are done depends on the trust and reputation we build by shipping quality products and improving the lives of our users.
SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” We bring fresh eyes to a stagnated and underserved domain. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.

Read some of our thoughts on engineering and company-building here.

Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.

Job Description

Are you energized by the challenge of building robust data management systems that become the backbone of critical scientific work? Do you light up at the intersection of solid software engineering and cutting-edge AI capabilities? We're seeking a software engineer who shares our excitement for creating elegant, scalable data solutions while pushing the boundaries of what's possible with artificial intelligence. This is your opportunity to work on systems where traditional engineering excellence meets the transformative potential of AI.

We are seeking a Full Stack Software Engineer
to design, develop, and maintain complex software systems supporting mission-critical analytical and operational workflows. You will contribute across the full technology stack, from modern web-based user interfaces to back-end services, data pipelines, and software quality assurance processes. This role requires close collaboration with scientists, engineers, and domain experts to translate complex requirements into robust, maintainable, and scalable software solutions. The work involves developing a modern data management system based on agentic AI workflows that integrate data models, data processing pipelines, and the integration of advanced AI-enabled tooling. This position is programmatically in the Strategic Threat Analysis and Response (STAR) organization and administratively in the Global Security Computing Applications Division (GS-CAD) within the Computing Directorate.

This position requires part-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.

This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.

You will

Collaborate with application owners and developers to analyze business and technical requirements.
Contribute to the deployment and architecture of both commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) and in-house developed applications.
Contribute to the design, development, test, and maintenance of full stack software applications to both front-end user interfaces and back-end services. This includes contributing to the development of front-end applications using modern web frameworks such as React or Angular and the development or back-end services using restful frameworks such as Python (Flask, FastAPI), or Node (Express, Nest, Fastify)
Support and enhance version control and change management workflows, including:
Tracking changes across evolving data and document versions

Contribute to the development of unit tests and supporting artifacts to ensure software quality, reliability, and maintainability to software quality assurance (SQA) documentation in accordance with project and organizational standards.
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including software developers, domain experts, and stakeholders, to gather requirements, participate in review designs, and provide high-quality software solutions to problems of moderate complexity.
Apply best practices in software engineering, including code reviews, documentation, configuration management, and secure development practices.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Additional Job Responsibilities, At The SES.3 Level

Serve as a technical contact for complex software development efforts, providing technical direction and mentoring to junior and mid-level developers.
Contribute to software quality assurance (SQA) activities, including defining testing approaches, reviewing test coverage, and ensuring compliance with project and organizational requirements.
Perform technical risk assessment and mitigation, identifying potential issues related to architecture, performance, maintainability, or data integrity and proposing effective solutions.

Qualifications

Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Broad experience as a full stack software developer, with contributions to both front-end development (React or Angular frameworks, HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and/or JavaScript) and back-end systems including experience with back-end services using modern Python or Node based frameworks (e.g., API design and integration with databases and external services.)
Proficiency with version control systems (e.g., Git), including branching strategies, change tracking, and collaborative development workflows.
Broad experience developing unit tests and supporting software quality assurance activities.
Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand moderately complex to complex requirements and translate into effective software solutions.
Proficient written and verbal communication skills, necessary to effectively collaborate in a team environment and present and explain technical information, with the ability to document designs and communicate technical concepts.

Additional Qualifications At The SES.3 Level

Advanced experience as a full stack software developer, including contributing to the design and implementation of complex, multi-component software systems.
Demonstrated ability to define and implement testing strategies and to lead software quality assurance (SQA) efforts, including unit testing, integration testing, and documentation.
Experience providing technical leadership and mentorship, including guiding other developers, reviewing designs and code, and promoting software engineering best practices.
Ability to work independently on ambiguous or complex problems, exercising sound technical judgment and initiative to develop effective solutions.

Qualifications We Desire

Master’s degree or PhD in applied data science, computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience with containerization platforms, such as Docker or Kubernetes, and related comprehensive knowledge of DevSecOps concepts.
Experience integrating artificial intelligence (AI) tools and techniques across the software development life cycle (SDLC), such as AI-assisted coding, automated testing, code review, and documentation, to improve developer productivity and software quality.
Comprehensive knowledge and broad experience with Neo4J or other graph databases, including querying, data modeling, and transformation of graph-based data.

$146,340 - $185,544 Annually at the SES.2 level

Overview

Baker Tilly is a leading advisory, tax and assurance firm, providing clients with a genuine coast-to-coast and global advantage in major regions of the U.S. and in many of the world’s leading financial centers – New York, London, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago and Boston. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP (Baker Tilly) provide professional services through an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable laws, regulations and professional standards. Baker Tilly US, LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities provide tax and business advisory services to their clients. Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.

Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP and Baker Tilly US, LLP, trading as Baker Tilly, are independent members of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion. Visit bakertilly.com or join the conversation on LinkedIn, Facebook and Instagram.

Please discuss the work location status with your Baker Tilly talent acquisition professional to understand the requirements for an opportunity you are exploring.

Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.

Job Description

What we're building

We're building AI agents that do real work for Baker Tilly's tax, assurance, and advisory teams. They read client files, find risks and opportunities, draft financial statement disclosures, and show their sources, and a practitioner always makes the final call. The data is some of the most sensitive in the business, so we build security in from the start.

Baker Tilly is the sixth-largest accounting and advisory firm in the U.S., with more than 11,000 people, and the firm is investing seriously in AI. We're a small team at the start of that work, and the engineers who join now will help decide what we build and how.

As a Full Stack Engineer, you'll build the screens practitioners use and the services behind them. You'll take well-scoped features from frontend to production and learn from experienced engineers as you go.

What you'll work with

Years of client engagement history, tax returns, and financial records, at the scale of a major firm.
Tax, audit, and advisory practitioners who help define what good looks like and review what the agents produce.
Real users inside the firm who give direct feedback on what you build.
We work in partnership with frontier labs.
A mix of building and buying. You'll help decide which is which, and everything we ship meets the same standards for security, tracing, and testing.
Our stack: Python, TypeScript and React, Databricks, graph and vector databases, MCP, OpenTelemetry, and Braintrust, on Azure.

What you'll do

Build features for our AI agents end to end: the screens practitioners use, the services behind them, and the data they read.
Build the tools our experts use to review agent output and flag what's wrong.
Work directly with practitioners to understand how they do their jobs, then turn that into software.
Connect to firm systems and data through APIs, with the right access controls.
Write tested, readable code. Review other people's code, and have yours reviewed.
Watch what you ship: tests, tracing, user feedback, and fixing what breaks.

added.title: Software Engineer, Applied AI
added.description:
Why Numeric

Every business runs on accounting, but the systems underneath it were built for a different era.
Today’s ERPs don’t store a company’s financial data. They store a diluted copy of it. Every contract, lease, and invoice gets flattened into a journal entry, and the context that made it meaningful is thrown away. That’s why accounting teams spend every month re-checking numbers, stitching together spreadsheets, and waiting on engineering, and why AI struggles to do real accounting work. Accounting doesn’t have a reporting problem. It has a data problem.

Enter Numeric: the data platform finance teams run on.
We started with the month-end close, where the data problem hurts most, and hundreds of finance teams now run their close on Numeric. That work led us to rebuild the system of record itself. In September 2026 we launched the Financial Data Platform (FDP)
, a platform built for the agent era. Instead of a journal entry, the real business object enters the system and the accounting is derived from it. Every number is traceable to its source, reporting works on any dimension, and accountants and AI agents finally have enough context to work together. While others bolted AI features onto the old data model, we built a new one.

We have a growing base of customers who love our product, including Anthropic, Plaid, Brex, Betterment, Wealthfront, and Asana. We’ve raised $89M from top-tier investors including IVP, Menlo Ventures, Founders Fund, and 8VC, along with founders and executives from Ramp, Segment, and other category-defining companies. We’re in-person, with teams in New York, San Francisco, and London, and we just shipped the product that will define our next decade. There’s never been a better time to join.

The Role

We are addressing these problems at their root by building the infrastructure and product experiences to ingest events, transform them, match value movement, project interpretations, and report against our unified graph of financial data. We’re applying principles of software engineering and data systems to scale accounting.

We tackle the hard problems. Accounting does not need more duct tape.

We’ve rethought the field—its primitives, assumptions, and practices—while staying grounded by working closely with our customers. As engineers, we do our homework. We study the domain and talk to our users, and by doing so we earn the right to bring a fresh perspective to the problem of financial data.

We’re turning accountants into engineers, and AI is a critical piece of that story. This role will lead the development of customer-facing AI experiences that make our platform usable, delightful, automated, auditable, and trusted. You’ll be responsible for building both user-facing features and the horizontal foundations we use to bring unified, trustworthy AI automation and experiences to our users. You’ll make strategic decisions and build the loops for how we measure and improve the efficacy of our AI product experiences.

You might be a fit if…

You’re curious by nature. You’re a generalist with a desire to work at the cutting edge of AI tech, and to build novel interaction patterns for a complex domain. You have an instinct to deeply understand your users and the problems they deal with. You like to see things for yourself.

What You Need

Generalist fullstack skills: experience with backend development and web development frameworks
You have experience shipping greenfield projects
You’ve built projects with modern AI (bonus points for business-facing contexts)

Bonus points for…

Work history in a relevant technical area: AI research, AI infra, or design

How We Work

This role is in-person in San Francisco
(in office, with flexibility).

As an engineer at Numeric you will learn the domain, meet your users, and exercise substantial creativity and agency over product direction. You'll work with a high-pace, high-integrity team that loves collaboration.

We believe the best company is the one with the best ICs and we’ve built a culture to maximize great work. We believe great product & engineering come from a desire to win, a deep care for the craft, and a pragmatism in shipping for overall impact. As engineers we ground our work in our understanding of the users, the domain, and the goals for our organization.

We strongly believe we will only be successful if everyone on the team is anchored in our following set of core principles:

Own the Outcome: We own our results. We typically hire builders and give them large mandates with high-trust. Engineers are responsible not just for code, but for ensuring the product is solving the end problems of the users.
Brick by Brick: To win, our team needs to show up and execute in each domain every day.
Love the Game: We focus on the craft and a deep sense of giving a f*ck. We’re building a company full of people who are equally engaged and motivated.
Earn the right: Our ability to rethink how things are done depends on the trust and reputation we build by shipping quality products and improving the lives of our users.
SALY: We refuse to accept “Same As Last Year.” We bring fresh eyes to a stagnated and underserved domain. We’re driven by a first-principles approach to building better solutions.

Read some of our thoughts on engineering and company-building here.

We now offer green card sponsorship from day one for technical roles.

added.description:
About Hexmodal

Hexmodal builds smart devices and a simple software platform that help facilities teams automate routine compliance testing, monitoring, and documentation. Our technology helps teams spend less time on manual rounds and more time on the maintenance work that keeps buildings operating safely. Today, Hexmodal supports more than 180 health systems across 48 states.

The Role (also the Mission)

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to add implementation and review bandwidth to our application team. This role is focused on feature development across our Django/Vue platform, which helps 3,000+ healthcare facilities stay safe and compliant through our IoT device fleet.

This is an empowered individual contributor role. We’ve focused a lot on building process and automations to allow for our developers to move quickly and work independently, without being blocked. In return, we expect you to be very fast and productive on your own work, bring real technical depth, and learn without needing much dedicated guidance.

We believe in diffusing responsibility across the team: engineers today should own more of the process end to end, and ownership over parts of the codebase is both motivating and a driver of productivity. Within your first 4 months, you will be assigned ownership of one or more modules of our application, becoming the go-to expert for their design, quality, and evolution.

You will also dedicate roughly 30% of your time to code reviews, a direct lever on the whole team's velocity. This role reports to our Application Lead and is based out of our NYC office 5 days a week.

Here are some ways you’ll make an impact (also Outcomes of the role)

Ship features end to end with high velocity and quality: scope, design, build, release, and iterate with customer feedback, with minimal oversight.
Within 6 months, be assigned ownership of one or more application modules, and act as their authority on design, quality, and roadmap input.
Dedicate ~30% of your time to code reviews, providing fast, rigorous, constructive feedback that keeps the team's velocity high and the codebase healthy.
Own production bugs and issues in your modules as part of the on-call/bug triage rotation, resolving them in a timely and structured manner and keeping affected users informed.
Improve the performance and maintainability of the modules you own through targeted refactors and query optimization.
Ramp up on new domains and tools independently, freeing lead time for the rest of the team.

Competencies we are looking for in the right candidate:

6+ years of professional software development experience, including 3+ years in a fast-moving startup or high-velocity environment.
A track record of high personal output: shipping complex features quickly without sacrificing quality.
Strong backend depth in Python. Django experience strongly preferred; depth with a comparable framework plus strong fundamentals counts.
Deep PostgreSQL expertise: schema design, query optimization, indexing, and performance tuning.
Demonstrated experience solving hard technical problems, such as scaling an application, large refactors, or performance bottlenecks.
Highly independent: learns new domains and tools on their own and makes sound technical decisions with minimal guidance.
Strong code review skills: thorough, fast feedback that improves code without slowing the team down.
Comfortable with operational ownership: debugging production issues and owning the fix through to resolution.
Proficient with AI coding tools as part of an efficient personal workflow.

Bonus Points: (Some nice to haves for this role)

Front-end experience with Vue.js
Experience with IoT devices and LoRaWAN
Experience with AWS and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in production
Experience building compliance-related software

Compensation & Benefits

We offer competitive compensation along with meaningful equity so you share in the value you help create.

Our benefits include:

401(k) match
100% coverage of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and 80% coverage for dependents
Paid parental leave (for all parents)
Unlimited PTO

Why Hexmodal

At Hexmodal, you’ll work on real problems with real-world constraints and have meaningful ownership over the results. We’re a growing team that values simplicity, accountability, curiosity, and respect for the facilities professionals we serve.

If you’re excited to build practical technology that makes an important job easier, we’d like to hear from you.

Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

Job Description

Location:

New York, NY

Senior Software Engineer, Publishing Platform (Frontend-focused Full Stack)

About Condé Nast

Condé Nast stands as a distinguished media powerhouse, celebrated for curating top-tier content for the globe's most impactful audiences. Engaging over a billion consumers through its cutting-edge print, digital, and video brands, the portfolio proudly features some of the most iconic titles in the media landscape, including Architectural Digest, Bon Appétit, Condé Nast Traveler, GQ, Pitchfork, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, Vogue, and WIRED.

Consistently delivering excellence, Condé Nast extends its influence across 32 markets worldwide, with headquarters in both London and New York, embodying a commitment to quality and innovation.

About Condé Nast Technology

Condé Nast Technology builds the products, systems, and experiences that power our brands. Our mission is to enable creativity and business growth through next-generation publishing, loyalty, and commerce platforms.

We’re a global team of designers, engineers, product managers, and researchers dedicated to creating innovative, user-centric products that enable world-class storytelling and digital experiences.

You’ll be part of a talented international team working across London, New York, and ten other markets, collaborating daily with colleagues in Product, Engineering, Architecture, Design, UX, and Data. We partner closely with Consumer Marketing, Commercial, Licensing, Editorial, and Brand teams to ensure our tools and experiences deliver real impact.

Together, we’re shaping how our brands create, publish, and connect with audiences worldwide, combining craft, technology, and collaboration to deliver quality at scale.

About Our Engineering Team

Our engineering team builds and evolves Verso, the shared front-end platform powering more than 70 Condé Nast brand sites worldwide. We specialize in modern React architectures, performance-optimized experiences, multi-brand configuration systems, and flexible storytelling tools that enable teams to move fast while maintaining exceptional quality.

We value craft. We value clarity. We value performance. We value governance. We believe that exceptional digital experiences require engineering, product and design working in lockstep.

About The Role

Our brands are our USP. The expression of our iconic brands – from Vogue to the New Yorker – within their digital experiences is of utmost importance in our mission to create the best places to consume and interact with our brands.

We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve Verso, our shared publishing platform. Your work will focus primarily on React and TypeScript interfaces, with ownership extending into the Node.js runtime, data fetching, and service integrations that power them. You’ll take changes from technical discovery through delivery and production support.

You’ll turn editorial and design needs into accessible, performant interfaces used across multiple brands and markets. This includes building shared components, supporting distinctive brand experiences through configuration, and improving the architecture that connects content to the page.

You’ll collaborate closely with our Product Design Lead, editorial partners, and platform engineers to bridge design intent with production-quality code.

Key Responsibilities & Areas Of Impact

Build and evolve the publishing platform
Build polished, high quality UI elements as React components with a strong focus on layout, typography and interactive fidelity.
Explain technical decisions and trade-offs to Design, Product, and Editorial partners. Agree on delivery milestones, communicate progress, and raise risks early.
Utilize modern React and Typescript features. Familiarity with React 18+, TypeScript, hooks, suspense, SSR concepts, and emerging RSC patterns are expected.
Write semantic, maintainable code with clear component and service boundaries. Use peer reviews to explain trade-offs, incorporate feedback, and improve the solution.. Your code should be written with long-term scalability in mind.
Work with GraphQL schemas, fragments, and resolvers to deliver efficient, minimal data payloads.
Shape GQL patterns that support component-driven design and editorial storytelling flows.
Design and deliver features across Verso’s React application, Node.js runtime, and service integrations, with clear ownership from implementation through production support.
Evolve the platform’s fetch, transform, and render architecture while keeping responsibilities and service boundaries clear.
Design configuration-driven solutions that support different brands and markets without introducing brand-specific application logic.
Identify and simplify fragile or duplicated platform patterns without unnecessarily rewriting working systems.
Mentor through example, helping teammates build their craft and front-end intuition.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly to accelerate discovery, prototyping, testing, documentation, and implementation, while maintaining strong ownership of code quality, security, accessibility, and performance.
Critically evaluate AI-generated code and recommendations, validating correctness through tests, peer review, observability, and sound engineering judgment.
Identify pragmatic opportunities to use AI to improve publishing workflows, developer experience, content operations, or front-end platform efficiency, in partnership with Product, Design, Editorial, and Data teams.
Contribute to responsible AI practices, including appropriate handling of confidential data, copyright-sensitive content, bias, attribution, human review, and brand/editorial integrity.

Contribute to our Multi-Tenant Application
Build shared components and configuration-driven capabilities that support distinctive brand experiences across markets.
Make deliberate trade-offs between reuse and brand-specific needs, keeping exceptions explicit, testable, and maintainable.
Participate in design reviews, architectural discussions, and platform strategy.
Set high standards for code quality, component architecture, performance best practices, and design fidelity

What We’re Looking For (Experience & Skills)

6+ years of experience developing high-quality production experiences using React and TypeScript.
Experience designing and consuming GraphQL APIs, including schemas, fragments, resolvers, schema evolution, and typed clients.
Experience building and maintaining Node.js applications or backend services, including API integrations and error handling.
Experience writing automated tests and diagnosing accessibility, rendering, and performance issues in production web applications.
Deep understanding of modern React (hooks, suspense, SSR/Hydration concepts).
Experience using logs, metrics, traces, and production evidence to diagnose root causes
Strong understanding of accessibility, usability, and inclusive design principles.
Curious mindset with a desire to learn, iterate, and push the platform forward.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, chat-based technical copilots, or AI-supported documentation/search workflows.
Ability to prompt, critique, test, and refine AI-generated outputs rather than accepting them unreviewed.
Awareness of responsible AI considerations, including privacy, security, intellectual property, accessibility, bias, and editorial trust.
Curiosity about AI-enabled product experiences and how they can support publishing, storytelling, personalization, discovery, or internal tooling.

Nice to have

Experience integrating AI-powered features into web applications, such as streaming responses, prompt-driven interfaces, semantic search, recommendations, summarization, or editorial assistance tools.
Familiarity with LLM APIs, embeddings, RAG patterns, evaluation workflows, or AI observability.
Experience designing user interfaces for AI-assisted workflows with clear feedback, confidence cues, human-in-the-loop review, and graceful failure states.

You’ll Thrive In This Role If

You enjoy following a problem across system boundaries, can balance immediate delivery with the health of a shared platform, and are comfortable owning a change from technical discovery through production operation.
Raise risks early, seek feedback, and help teammates make progress.
Improve existing systems incrementally and choose carefully when a larger change is justified.

A note: research indicates that women and individuals from marginalised groups tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If you believe you’re qualified, but don’t necessarily check every box, please submit an application.

The expected base salary range for this position is from $175k - $195k. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply below, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

added.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Role

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on engineering role with deep technical ownership. The constraints are unusual: everything ships into fully air-gapped, accredited environments, which means offline builds, vendor dependencies, and a pipeline that produces the evidence our accreditations require.

What You'll Do

Design and build production web applications in React, GO and Rust that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.
Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.
Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.
Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.
Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

Required Qualifications

Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.
Professional experience developing backend services in Go.
Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.
Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.
Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.
Experience communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.
Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

Desired Qualifications

Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.
Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.
Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.

added.title: Software Engineer, Education
added.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Role

Anthropic is seeking a Software Engineer to help build the technical foundation for how Anthropic educates customers and enterprises at scale, and to shape what that even means when AI is the delivery mechanism, not just the subject being taught.

Your work will define how millions of people experience learning about Claude: how content is served and adapted in real time, how assessments respond to what a learner actually understands, how credentialing systems verify genuine competence rather than course completion, and how the entire platform evolves as fast as the product it teaches. You'll build the infrastructure that makes AI-native education real — not as a concept, but as a working system that people interact with every day.

You’ll own the technical vision for our AI-driven educational experience: the platform layer, enterprise readiness features, the data architecture, the AI-augmented pipelines, the integrations, and the delivery systems. You'll work with a handful of highly technical educational collaborators to own the technical vision and execution for how Anthropic’s education team delivers educational experiences at scale, and you'll build the AI-augmented pipelines and platform capabilities that let a small team of educators operate with reach and responsiveness that would otherwise require an organization ten times larger.

This is an engineering role for someone who genuinely cares about how people learn. You'll make platform decisions that are deeply educational, and you need the judgment to make those decisions well, not just implement someone else's spec. You'll interface closely with Anthropic's security, infrastructure, and data teams, and you'll partner with trainers and educators on the GTM, devrel, and education teams who will be your primary stakeholders.

Responsibilities

Architect and own Anthropic’s enterprise ready education platform and infrastructure — authentication/SSO, learner data models, content delivery, credentialing, and progress tracking — designed for scale, AI-forward features, and reliability from day one
Own the technical vision for how Anthropic delivers AI-driven educational experiences and shaping what's possible, not just building what's requested. You’ll determine what to build, what to extend, and what to replace as needs evolve
Build AI-augmented pipelines for content generation, real-time adaptation, assessment delivery, and quality assurance — working closely with the education team to understand what these systems need to do pedagogically
Design platform capabilities that enable genuinely new kinds of empowering learning experiences — adaptive paths, competency-based progression, AI-evaluated demonstrations of skill — not just digital versions of traditional courses
Interface with Anthropic's security, infrastructure, and data teams to ensure education systems meet organizational standards and integrate cleanly with existing architecture
Build platform abstractions that let non-engineers on the team configure, extend, and experiment with educational experiences without engineering bottlenecks
Make product-level decisions about how the platform works — you're shaping what the learning experience is, not just serving it

You may be a good fit if you have

7+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to take a platform from zero to production at scale
Genuine passion for education — you think about how people learn, you have opinions about what educational technology should look like in an AI-native world, and you want to build it
A strong eye for quality educational content, with a sense of the complex systems that produce it
Full-stack engineering skills with particular strength in backend systems: databases, APIs, authentication, reliability, and infrastructure
Experience building and operating platforms that serve many concurrent users reliably
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership: you'll need to translate pedagogical intent into technical architecture without heavy specification
Experience interfacing with security and infrastructure teams to meet organizational requirements while maintaining development velocity
A working practice of using AI tools in your own engineering workflows — and genuine curiosity about how AI fundamentally changes what educational platforms can be

Strong candidates may also have

Experience building or significantly contributing to learning platforms, credentialing systems, or educational technology products
Background in or exposure to learning science, instructional design, or educational research
Experience with SSO/identity (SAML, OAuth), badging standards (Open Badges), or LTI integrations
Familiarity with building systems that incorporate LLM capabilities as core infrastructure
Prior work at a high-growth company where you built platform infrastructure that other teams depended on
Experience designing systems that non-technical users configure and operate

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$320,000—$405,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. added.title: Full Stack Engineer, Builder Experience
added.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Builder Experience Team makes it easier for Stripe’s product teams to build the right products, ship them with confidence, and help users realize value from them.

In order to build a great product, product teams must develop a deep understanding of users, shape and test ideas, coordinate across functions, navigate launch requirements, identify risks, gather feedback, and manage products after launch. Today, many of these workflows are fragmented, manual, or built around processes and tools that predate recent advances in AI.

We are a small, AI-native team reimagining how Stripe builds, ships, and ramps products. We experiment with new approaches across AI agents, automation, and process—and scale the ones that work. Our initial areas of focus include reinventing launch readiness from gates into guidelines, giving product teams richer and more timely context, and shortening the feedback loops between builders, users, Sales, and Support.

Our users are Stripe’s product managers, engineers, designers, researchers – and we help to simplify the interactions with the cross-functional teams that help bring products to market. We work closely with teams including all of our business unit PMs, Product Operations, and Kai, Stripe’s internal AI platform.

What you'll do

We’re looking for product-minded engineers who want to rethink how products get built—not simply digitize existing processes. You’ll identify high-friction parts of Stripe’s product-development lifecycle, rapidly prototype new approaches, put them in the hands of real teams, and turn the strongest experiments into scaled solutions used by every product team at Stripe.

This is a hands-on role with broad product and technical scope. You’ll work across the stack, combining traditional software engineering with emerging AI capabilities. You’ll operate in ambiguous problem spaces where the right product, interface, and technical architecture must be discovered together.

You Will

Design and build tools that help Stripe teams shape better products, ship with greater speed and confidence, and learn from users more quickly.
Develop AI-native workflows and agents that synthesize context, automate repetitive work, surface risks, and help builders make better decisions.
Own projects end to end: identify high-value problems, develop prototypes, test them with users, measure their impact, and scale the approaches that work.
Work across backend systems, data sources, internal platforms, and polished user-facing experiences.
Partner directly with product managers, engineers, designers, researchers, and cross-functional teams to understand how work happens in practice.
Integrate with platforms such as Kai and Compass while identifying where new foundational capabilities are needed.
Apply strong judgment to the use of sensitive internal context, including appropriate attention to security, privacy, permissions, and user trust.
Help define how the team operates, including its technical foundations, product-development practices, and standards for experimentation and quality.
Contribute to the team’s roadmap by identifying systemic sources of friction and opportunities to improve Stripe’s product-development lifecycle.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

5+ years of backend and/or full-stack software development experience
Demonstrated technical experience leading the design and delivery of new product experiences from prototype to production
Strong full-stack engineering skills, including experience building reliable backend services and polished user-facing product experiences.
Ability to operate effectively in high-ambiguity environments: framing problems, experimenting & adjusting, making right-sized technical decisions, and creating an actionable path forward.
Excellent cross-functional and cross-organizational collaboration skills, with the ability to align teams with different systems, priorities, and constraints.
Strong engineering judgment around system reliability, operational excellence, security, and maintainability.
A product-minded approach to engineering, with a focus on delivering meaningful outcomes for users and the business.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Java, Ruby, and/or TypeScript. We care more about strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn than expertise in a particular language or framework.
Experience delivering user facing products at Stripe (Payments, MM, RevSuite, etc), or experience delivering user facing products pre-dating Stripe.
Experience working on 0→1 products or taking new capabilities from concept through launch and iteration.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $190,400 - $285,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Experience with data formats and interfaces such as JSON, CSV, XML, REST APIs, sockets, message queues, or similar mechanisms.
Experience with databases and data storage technologies such as PostgreSQL, SQLite, InfluxDB, object storage, or similar systems.
Experience with software revision control systems such as Git, SVN, or similar tools.
Ability to troubleshoot software issues across applications, operating systems, networks, and external system interfaces.

Experience with data analytics, signal processing, machine learning, or algorithm implementation in Python.
Experience with Python web or API frameworks such as Flask, FastAPI, Django, Dash, or similar tools.
